problem_text: A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 2.5 m/s^2 for 12 s. Find (a) the car's final speed and (b) the distance it travels during this time.

A projectile is launched from ground level at 25 m/s at an angle of 40 degrees above the horizontal. Ignoring air resistance (g=9.8 m/s^2), find the time of flight, the maximum height, and the horizontal range.
Two blocks of mass 4 kg and 6 kg are connected by a string over a frictionless pulley (Atwood machine). Find the acceleration and the tension.
A block slides down a 30 degree incline with kinetic friction coefficient 0.2. Starting from rest, find the acceleration and the speed after sliding 4 m.
A 2 kg block compresses a spring (k=500 N/m) by 0.15 m on a frictionless surface. Find the block's speed when released.
A 3 kg cart at 4 m/s collides and sticks to a stationary 5 kg cart. Find the final velocity and the kinetic energy lost.
A solid disk (M=2 kg, R=0.25 m) at rest has a constant torque of 0.6 N*m applied. Find the angular acceleration and angular speed after 5 s.
A satellite orbits Earth at 500 km altitude. Using Earth's mass and radius, find the orbital speed and period.
Two point charges, +3 uC and -5 uC, are separated by 0.2 m. Find the force between them.
Find the electric field at 0.5 m from a point charge of +8 uC.
A uniformly charged insulating sphere (R=0.1 m, Q=4 uC) — find E at r=0.05 m and r=0.3 m.
A 4 ohm and 6 ohm resistor in series, that combination in parallel with 12 ohm, across a 12 V source. Find R_eq and branch currents.
A 2 kOhm resistor and 100 uF capacitor in series with a 9 V battery, charging from zero. Find tau and V_C at t=tau.
A proton at 2e6 m/s enters a 0.5 T field perpendicular to its velocity. Find the radius and period of its circular path.
A wire (I=5 A, L=0.3 m) is perpendicular to a 0.8 T field. Find the force.
A circular loop (r=0.05 m) sits in a field changing at 0.2 T/s. Find the induced EMF.
